subject.title: fix(qa-lab): reject hex/exponent Telegram SUT uid env values

question: Should Telegram QA SUT UID, GID, and cleanup-timeout environment values become decimal-only even though custom launchers using JavaScript hex, exponent, or fractional forms will stop working?
rationale: The implementation and proof establish the new behavior, but repository automation cannot decide whether existing non-decimal launcher inputs are an unsupported accident or a compatibility contract worth preserving.

options.title: Accept Decimal-Only Contract
options.body: Approve the intentional narrowing and merge after the exact rebased head completes required checks.

options.title: Preserve Existing Inputs
options.body: Keep Number-compatible forms accepted and close or revise this PR unless a separately documented strict mode is desired.

recommendation.title: Accept Decimal-Only Contract
recommendation.body: Approve the intentional narrowing and merge after the exact rebased head completes required checks.
